# etcher v0.7.1 - Table of Contents

> Annotation overlay for Fresco viewers in Phoenix. Draw shapes on `<Fresco.canvas>` and `<FrescoStrip.viewer>`; annotations live inside the host's extensions map and travel with the .fresco file (canvas) or the strip's serialized state.

## Pages

- [Etcher](https://etcher.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://etcher.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://etcher.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Etcher](https://etcher.hexdocs.pm/Etcher.md): Etcher is the annotation overlay for [Fresco](https://hex.pm/packages/fresco)
canvases in Phoenix.
- [Etcher.Layer](https://etcher.hexdocs.pm/Etcher.Layer.md): Phoenix LiveView function component that attaches Etcher's annotation
overlay to a named `<Fresco.canvas>` or `<Fresco.scroll_strip>`.
- [Etcher.Raster](https://etcher.hexdocs.pm/Etcher.Raster.md): Server-side, dependency-free rendering of Etcher annotations to static output.
